data.body: **P1 — Preserve immediate durable suspension.** Although `runUntilCompleteOrSuspend` may already have selected PENDING/RETRYING, this waits for `invokeHandler()` to exit before reading that outcome. A caught suspension or blocked `finally` therefore keeps Lambda running until timeout—even without plugins—contrary to the immediate-suspension contract. Decouple the response from handler completion, or bound the same-thread cleanup handoff against Lambda's remaining time and fail for invocation retry before the deadline; add wait/retry tests with a non-returning `finally`.
